biography:
As Vice President, Corporate Real Estate, I improve and shape the work experience of colleagues around the world.

Since 2017, I led the change from traditional office space to a hybrid working model globally, long before Covid-19 made this commonplace. At the request of the CEO, I put my datacenter development work to one side and globalized a disparate portfolio of locally managed office spaces. Today this consists of 109 offices over 50 countries with 102 staff, united by the intent to "Delight our customers".

Through the shift in model, a new deal was provided to both the company and the staff: highly functional, sustainable and elegant office spaces with every modern amenity, managed by a diverse  team, delivered along with a multi-million cost savings program.

Before moving to the Bay Area, I was Equinix Head of Real Estate EMEA, based in Amsterdam. In that role I quadrupled the size of Equinix's European data center portfolio over 5 years, trained up a datacentre real estate team of 6 from first principles, and changed the model for multi-data centre campuses across the region. By the time I moved role to set up and lead Corporate Real Estate, 85% of EBITDA in the EMEA region came from datacenters where I had led the real estate transaction.

My career in real estate started back in 1998, building up extensive experience and contacts working at the leading advisory firms - 10 years at JLL, 3 years at CBRE – culminating in pan-European and Global roles positions based in London and Helsinki.  Apart from business management, I have specialized in roles across professional advisory (Landlord & Tenant and Valuation), real estate development (Corporate Finance and Development Funds), as well as Corporate Real Estate, Lease Administration and Workplace. 

My working passion lies in seeing and unlocking talent in those around me - especially in people who have been overlooked or cannot see it in themselves - and creating a safe space for everyone to thrive.
